greeting: Down here, we don't measure depth in feet. We measure it in DEGREES.
Magma-Mole Morris! I dig where others MELT!
You look too... intact. Surface dweller, eh?
Back for more? Thought the heat'd scare you off!
Welcome to the HOT ZONE! Where the ore glows and the miners don't!
Need something from the deep? I'm your mole!
The magma flows and so do I! Adapt or evaporate!
Heat doesn't bother me anymore. Lost my sweat glands years ago!
dialog.mining_exploits: Dug through a magma vein once. Lost my favorite pick. And my eyebrows. But found a CRYSTAL the size of your HEAD!
dialog.heat_tolerance: Started with heat suits. Then just thick clothes. Now? Tank top and stubbornness. The body adapts!
dialog.deep_discoveries: Down deep, we find things. Crystals that sing. Stones that remember. The earth has SECRETS.
dialog.union_complaints: Management wants us deeper. UNION says 'find robots.' Robot won't work down here. Too melty. We stay.
rumor: The tunnels connect to everywhere. Dustbelt. Obsidian. Even Frost, if you go deep enough.
Something moves in the magma. Not bubbles. Something... alive.
Old-timers say there's a city down there. Pre-Collapse. Full of GOLD.
Tide's got underwater tunnels. Opposite problem. Same solution: keep digging.
dialog.retirement_plans: Two more years. Gonna buy a boat. Something on WATER. Cold water. With FISH. Never seen a fish.
farewell: Stay cool! Or hot! Whatever keeps you alive!
Don't let the surface make you SOFT!
Keep your pick sharp and your water closer!
Come back if you need something from the DEEP!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning shift! Coolest part of the day. Still 90 degrees.
dialog.time_noon: Peak heat! Magma's restless! Watch your step!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening cooldown. Best time to find solid ground.
dialog.time_night: Night shift! The tunnels glow prettier in the dark.

party_reactions.kade: This is the toughest job I've ever seen. Respect.
party_reactions.nix7: Human heat tolerance exceeded. Biological adaptation: impressive.
party_reactions.twist: You're like a MOLE! But for FIRE! That's AWESOME!
party_reactions.korr: The deep places hold many secrets. You find them well.
party_reactions.renna: Do you ever encounter magical deposits? Crystallized mana?
party_reactions.suresh: To work in such conditions requires dedication. Or desperation.
party_reactions.sova: I'd last five minutes down here. Maybe four.
party_reactions.grit: Harder than any trench. You're tough, mole-man.
party_reactions.ashka: You work WITH the fire! Not against it! SMART!
party_reactions.senna: Deep tunnels. Good hiding. I'll remember this.
party_reactions.callum: Aren't you... hot? You look really hot.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. Stay away from the magma pools.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back. Either brave or foolish. Both useful down here.
relationship_dialog.friend: My surface friend! Come to hear more tales from the deep?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My favorite customer! Here - take this heat stone. Stays warm forever. Don't ask how.
